business_summary: Sokensha Co.,Ltd. engages in the wholesale of natural and health foods, and other related products in Japan. It offers products including fats and oils such as margarine, safflower oil, perilla oil, olive oil, coconut oil, rapeseed oil, salad oil for raw materials, sesame oil, and camelina oil; and seasonings such as soy sauce, miso, sugar, salt, vinegar, curry, stew, mayonnaise, dressing, liquid stock, granulated stock, fermented seasonings, and honey. The company also offers confectionery and beverages including vegetable and fruit juices, tea, dried fruit, multi-grain tea, fermented beverages, nuts, and soy milk; dried foods and grains such as wheat flour, breadcrumbs, rice, black rice, mixed grains, dried bonito flakes, kelp, hijiki seaweed, lotus root flour, adlay grains, glutinous millet, rolled barley, quinoa, dried daikon radish, chia seeds, roasted sesame seeds, glutinous barley, seasoned seaweed, dried sakura shrimp, tapioca powder, okara, and protein powder; and side foods including jam, soup, retort foods, noodles, canned goods, aged fermented black garlic, pancake mix, pickled shallots in sweet vinegar, cereals, miso soup, New Year's bento boxes, seasoned rice mix, mixed sushi mix, tempura, corned beef, peanut spread, and Kamachi. In addition, it offers dietary supplements such as green juice, aloe vera, plum extract, euglena, Job's tears enzyme, lactic acid bacteria, Tiencha extract, collagen, Goishi tea, ginger powder, Banlangen, rooibos tea, lutein, moringa, bamboo grass extract, and vitamin C; and other products including toiletries, machinery and equipment, cosmetics, insect repellent sprays, toothpaste, and virus prevention products. The company was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.
